acceptance: `uv tool list` reports todo-db 0.12.0 or later, installed from the release wheel pinned to its `SHA256SUMS` hash.
The global template pins the catalog at `e7b7fd9` or later, merged through review; `~/.skill-sync-deployment` is applied and passes `skill-sync verify` and `check`.
With owner approval, the three loader links point to a release snapshot built from that pin, and the served `todo/SKILL.md` documents `drop(reason=...)`.
context: Found 2026-11-01 while filing follow-ups. The 0.11.0 rollout (global-install-and-skill-behind-0-11-0) shows the exact commands.
description:
v0.12.0 (2026-10-31) made `drop` require `reason`. BenchBox (vendored `todo_db-0.12.0` wheel, catalog pin `e7b7fd9`) and this repository (catalog pin `e7b7fd9`, todo-db#60) moved to it. The global layer did not:
- `uv tool list` reports todo-db v0.11.0.
- skill-sync-skills `deployment/global/skill-sync.conf` still pins the catalog at `c624975`, so the global `todo/SKILL.md` served through `~/.claude/skills`, `~/.codex/skills` and `~/.agents/skills` (release `c6249751…`) has no `drop(reason=...)` guidance from skill-sync-skills#101 (`e7b7fd9`).

These are steps 1 and 3 of the "After the tag" section in `docs/operations/release-gates.md`, which landed (todo-db#56) before the 0.12.0 tag and were skipped for it. Global sessions are consistent today (0.11.0 server, pre-0.12.0 skill text), so move both halves together: a 0.12.0 server with the old text makes agents' drops fail with E_STATE, and the new text on a 0.11.0 server passes a `reason` that tool does not accept.
